## 170ec3daa52f

**Reproduced override-contract defect; target left unchanged.** Generator SHA-256 `8c7736529a43bdf5a10f2330797a0a16629a4b4fc7c3f270e3ff6c2314ff8960`, canonical rule hash `dc39c00f06cc`.

At seed 0, sample index 0, medium difficulty, I supplied all advertised controls including `grid_h=4` and `grid_w=14`. The generator returned a 4×17 grid and `self_check` returned no findings. It also accepted an unknown `typo_axis=1`, again returning a validator-clean 4×17 grid. The exact kwargs, returned grid, shapes, and source hashes are in `checks/audit/170ec3daa52f/override-contract-counterexample.json`.

A source-bound full battery independently confirmed the broader contract failure: 7 stages green and 5 failed (`lint`, `defect_lint`, `profile_floor`, `semantic_gate`, `override`) in `checks/audit/170ec3daa52f/battery/checks/170ec3daa52f_after_battery_summary.json`. The target has no rule pin, dead/overlapping texture declarations, only 7/60 canonical-envelope hits, no executable semantic contract, and thousands of override findings. This is a concrete defect, not a suspected shortcut; no audit-target source was edited.

## 170ec3daa52f

**A2 — Source-matching prior defect independently reproduced; target left unchanged.**
Generator SHA-256
`8c7736529a43bdf5a10f2330797a0a16629a4b4fc7c3f270e3ff6c2314ff8960`;
executed/catalog rule hash `dc39c00f06cc`.

At seed 0 / sample 0 / medium, supplying every advertised fixed control—including
`grid_h=4` and `grid_w=14`—returns a validator-clean **4x17** grid. Unknown
`typo_axis=1` is also accepted. At seed 19 / sample 3 / hard, `variant=0` and `variant=2`
produce byte-identical grids, so the advertised variant axis is dead.

The exact calls and grids are in
`checks/audit/170ec3daa52f/override-contract-counterexample.json`; the 4x17 generated
input's actual Racket output is in `checks/audit/170ec3daa52f/racket.json`. This replay
matches the unresolved audit already indexed in
`repo/generators/170ec3daa52f/evidence/review_index.json`, including its current source
hash, rather than relying on the old report alone. No source under this audit target was
edited.
